    {{< include slides/_workflow-8step.qmd >}}   (from the site root, e.g. syllabus.qmd)

-->

::: {.small}
| # | Step | What you produce |
|--:|------|------------------|
| 1 | **Estimand** | The quantity you want to learn about, stated precisely as a target before any model is fitted. |
| 2 | **Data summary** | The data described: measurement, coverage, obvious issues. |
| 3 | **Formal model** | Likelihood and priors written down, the generative model. |
| 4 | **Prior predictive check** | Simulate from the priors, confirm they imply plausible data. |
| 5 | **Fit** | Estimate with `brms`, weakly-informative priors by default. |
| 6a | **MCMC diagnostics** | R-hat, ESS, divergences, trace plots. Did sampling work? |
| 6b | **Posterior predictive check** | Does the fitted model reproduce key features of the data? |
| 7 | **Interpretation** | Answer the estimand on the outcome scale, with uncertainty. |
| 8 | **Limitations** | What the analysis can and cannot support, threats and next steps. |

: The 8-step Bayesian workflow. Every homework exercises the steps introduced so far, cumulatively, and the exam runs all eight end to end. {#tbl-workflow}
:::
